name: Dutchman
description: Convert Fusion, Inventor, SolidWorks and FreeCAD designs into editable SolidCraft designs

editable_history.title: Keep editable history
editable_history.description: Keep mapped body-building features beside the visible original geometry. Reference sketches are retained in either mode.

up_axis.title: Up axis
up_axis.description: As is keeps source coordinates. Stand up changes source Y-up to Z-up.

include_hidden_bodies.title: Include hidden bodies
include_hidden_bodies.description: Also include hidden intermediate or consumed shapes that normal conversion leaves out.
